title: Which country's representative office in Ramallah will have its diplomats stripped of their Israeli-issued diplomatic status in September 2026?
background: Foreign governments maintain representative offices to conduct diplomatic relations with the Palestinian Authority.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Public announcements by Israel's Foreign Ministry, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose diplomats at its representative office in Ramallah are formally announced to have had their Israeli-issued diplomatic status revoked during September 2026. The announcement of revocation is sufficient; implementation need not be independently verified. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.
